repairs.finding: Routed-expert element counts for 64, 128 and 256 experts per layer were inconsistent with the byte accounting.
repairs.change: Corrected docs/PREFILLER.md to 15,099,494,400; 30,198,988,800; and 60,397,977,600 elements. Byte values were already correct.

repairs.finding: Weighted router coverage treated zero weights as unit activations, mixing serve-mode activation counts into router-weight share.
repairs.change: Weighted mode now rejects a zero weight and directs the user to --unweighted; unweighted mode still counts activations.

repairs.finding: Duplicate-heading anchor suffixes could repeat after a third heading with the same text.
repairs.change: Heading slug generation now tracks each base slug independently so GitHub-style -1 and -2 suffixes remain unique.

repairs.finding: The durable prefiller receipt contained a one-character source-revision typo.
repairs.change: Rebound it to the existing base commit 1e8263888c38d7c2cde6deee2bded975efd38d94.

repairs.finding: Native-expert validation treated offsets as uniform without relating each row's blob_bytes to its 512-expert stride.
repairs.change: The parser now requires cumulative blob_bytes * n_expert offsets and exact final byte accounting.

repairs.finding: Out-of-range profile pairs could be silently discarded and replaced by geometric fills.
repairs.change: Profile loading now rejects every layer/expert pair outside Flash-Next's 48x512 geometry.

repairs.finding: The README contract checker did not require the status heading before counting table rows.
repairs.change: A README without 'Project status and governance' now fails explicitly.

repairs.finding: The architecture common-quality description omitted the newly wired docs and prefiller checks.
repairs.change: Updated the canonical quality-mode row to name README/docs navigation and both planner test domains.

tests_added: zero router weight is rejected in weighted mode and counted in unweighted mode
third duplicate Markdown heading produces the -2 GitHub suffix

validation.command: ruff check tools/prefiller_plan.py tools/test_prefiller_plan.py scripts/check_docs.py scripts/tests/test_check_docs.py
ruff format --check tools/prefiller_plan.py tools/test_prefiller_plan.py scripts/check_docs.py scripts/tests/test_check_docs.py

non_claims: The corrected element counts are metadata arithmetic, not a new model run or benchmark.
No engine, trainer, accelerator or runtime behavior changed.
CodeRabbit ast-grep subprocess warnings on test argv lists were not repaired because the tests use argv lists without a shell; this is recorded as reviewer tooling noise, not an accepted code defect.
